raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Qwen VLM actors now freeze the vision encoder by default, with explicit CLI overrides for the vision model, projection, and language model. AWEX reuses visual embeddings only when the live actor parameters prove the vision encoder is frozen; otherwise successful weight-update cache flushes invalidate embeddings. The first successful flush always clears old visual state.

## Related Issue

No linked public issue.

## Type of Change

- [x] New feature

## Validation

146 CPU tests passed, 2 skipped. Full `pre-commit run --all-files` and normal commit hooks passed for every commit.

```bash
python -m pytest -q -m "not slow" tests/test_megatron_vision_freezing.py tests/test_megatron_bridge_deterministic.py tests/test_qwen_flash_next_training.py tests/test_awex_sglang_plugin.py tests/test_awex_visual_cache_policy.py
```

GPU and multi-node integration were not rerun for this history split. Optional-dependency checks skip when their packages are unavailable.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant regression tests pass
- [x] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] Created via the `/create-pr` workflow
- [ ] Breaking change

## Additional Context

Depends on #1811. Once that base PR merges, retarget/rebase this PR onto `main`.

Based on `chucai.dzq/pr-qwen38-27b-rl-20261021` at `23913f66028e`. This branch contains only its scoped fixes and regression coverage; temporary test scripts, investigation notes, and experiment logs are excluded.

CLI/reference documentation is included; the documentation site build was not rerun.

Post-creation `/review-pr` review and expert consultation completed. All reported findings are resolved and re-reviewed. The four branches merge without conflicts and preserve the source branch fixes. A combined 31-file CPU regression run passed 1,148 tests, with 8 optional-dependency/CUDA skips; the subsequent documentation-only correction passed full pre-commit checks. GPU and multi-node training were not rerun.

+## Freezing Vision Parameters
+
+Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5 (including Qwen3.8-27B) using `megatron-bridge` freeze the vision
+encoder and its projector/merger by default. No environment variable or CLI override is
+needed. The explicit equivalent is:
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  megatron:
+    bridge_type: megatron-bridge
+    freeze_vision_model: true
+    freeze_vision_projection: true
+```
+
+The equivalent CLI overrides are `actor.megatron.freeze_vision_model=true` and
+`actor.megatron.freeze_vision_projection=true`. These settings reach the native model
+provider before DDP and optimizer construction. To freeze only the encoder while keeping
+the merger trainable, set `freeze_vision_model: true` and
+`freeze_vision_projection: false`. Freeze both components to keep cached visual
+embeddings valid across language-model updates, assuming the image preprocessing is
+unchanged.
+
+Both options default to `null`: Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5 resolve this to `true`, while other
+models preserve their provider's freezing policy. Set either option to `false` to train
+that component. Explicit settings with an unsupported bridge or provider raise an error.
+Qwen4-Exp (Qwen3.8 Flash Next) uses a separate `mcore-bridge` adapter that already
+freezes its entire `visual` module, including its merger, without these options.
+
 ## MoE Parallel Strategy
 
 For MoE models, Megatron supports separate parallelism for attention and FFN modules

+    model.vision_model.requires_grad_(False)
+    if trainable_part is not None:

+    # Language weights remain trainable in every case.

+import pytest

+

+
+def test_vision_freezing_cli_overrides_survive_structured_config():
+    config = OmegaConf.structured(
+        TrainEngineConfig(
+            backend="megatron:d1",
+            experiment_name="vision-freezing",
+            trial_name="test",
+        )
+    )
+
+    parsed = OmegaConf.to_object(
+        OmegaConf.merge(
+            config,
+            OmegaConf.from_dotlist(
+                [
+                    "megatron.bridge_type=megatron-bridge",
+                    "megatron.freeze_vision_model=true",
+                    "megatron.freeze_vision_projection=true",
+                ]
+            ),
+        )
+    )
+
+    assert parsed.megatron.freeze_vision_model is True
+    assert parsed.megatron.freeze_vision_projection is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bridge_type", ["mbridge", "mcore-bridge"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("option", ["freeze_vision_model", "freeze_vision_projection"])
+def test_vision_freezing_unsupported_bridge_raises(bridge_type, option):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="require bridge_type='megatron-bridge'"):
+        MegatronEngineConfig(bridge_type=bridge_type, **{option: True})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("freeze_encoder", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("freeze_projection", [False, True])
+def test_qwen35_native_freeze_keeps_frozen_weights_out_of_optimizer(
+    freeze_encoder, freeze_projection
+):
+    # Exercise the installed provider's actual freeze contract without creating
+    # a distributed VLM. In particular, encoder-only freezing re-enables mergers.
+    module = pytest.importorskip(
+        "megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.model"
+    )
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.language_model = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)
+    model.vision_model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.vision_model.encoder = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)
+    model.vision_model.merger = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)
+    model.vision_model.decoder = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.vision_model.decoder.deepstack_merger_list = torch.nn.ModuleList(
+        [torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)]
+    )
+    for parameter in model.parameters():
+        torch.nn.init.constant_(parameter, 0.25)
+
+    module.Qwen3VLModel.freeze(
+        model,
+        freeze_language_model=False,
+        freeze_vision_model=freeze_encoder,
+        freeze_vision_projection=freeze_projection,
+    )
+    before = {
+        name: parameter.detach().clone() for name, parameter in model.named_parameters()
+    }
+    optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(
+        [parameter for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad],
+        lr=0.1,
+    )
+    hidden = model.vision_model.encoder(torch.ones(1, 2))
+    visual = model.vision_model.merger(hidden)
+    visual = visual + model.vision_model.decoder.deepstack_merger_list[0](hidden)
+    model.language_model(visual).square().mean().backward()
+    optimizer.step()
+
+    for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+        expected_frozen = (
+            freeze_encoder
+            if name.startswith("vision_model.encoder.")
+            else freeze_projection
+            if name.startswith("vision_model.")
+            else False
+        )
+        assert parameter.requires_grad is not expected_frozen
+        if expected_frozen:
+            assert parameter.grad is None
+            assert all(
+                parameter is not candidate
+                for group in optimizer.param_groups
+                for candidate in group["params"]
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(parameter, before[name], rtol=0, atol=0)
+        else:
+            assert parameter.grad is not None
+            assert not torch.equal(parameter, before[name])
